form.official-title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule issued by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to the California State Nonroad Engine Pollution Control Standards; Commercial Harbor Craft Regulations; Notice of Decision.

section.text: That Congress disapproves the rule issued by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to the California State Nonroad Engine Pollution Control Standards; Commercial Harbor Craft Regulations; Notice of Decision (90 Fed. Reg. 1998 (January 10, 2025)), and such rule shall have no force or effect.

attestation-group.attestation-date: Passed the House of Representatives September 16, 2026.
